text:
Evan L: Quick sync — proposing a 2-week enablement sprint to produce a partner-facing reference lab + Terraform module gallery for our HW partners (Equinix / Lambda). Goal: sample TF modules + smoke CI + README + runbook. Thoughts?

Priya K: Love the idea. Who's the primary audience — partner SREs or our marketplace onboarding team?

Evan L: Both. Primary deliverables: 
- reference architecture doc (network, storage, model serving patterns)
- three opinionated Terraform modules (networking baseline, model-serving stack, kms/secret-bootstrap)
- CI smoke harness + validation tests (x86 + arm matrix)
- quickstart repo with examples and a short notebook
- partner runbook + checklist for marketplace submission

Alex M: Can we lean on refkit modules and add partner overlays instead of full rewrites? Prefer extracting patterns: provider aliasing, variable defaults, semantic module outputs. Example snippet: 
```hcl
module "redwood_model" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refkit.git//modules/model_deploy?ref=v1.2.0"
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  enable_gpu = true
}
```
Keep modules small and composable.

Jon S: DevEx can own the quickstart notebook + a short tutorial video. We'll convert the notebook into a runnable GH Actions job for smoke tests.

Maya C: From partner enablement POV: recommend naming + semver for modules: redwood.partner.<partner>.<pattern>@v1. Also provide a lightweight policy checklist (IAM, private endpoints, egress rules). Need a small test matrix doc for arm vs x86 and Ampere vs Nvidia.

Selena R: I can provision a tiny smoke pool in our Dedicated sandbox for CI runs. Would like the CI to fail fast (5m max) and only run full matrix on scheduled nightly.

Priya K: Proposed timeline: 
- Week A: module skeletons + README templates + initial refarch draft
- Week B: CI harness + smoke tests + docs + partner review session

Evan L: Action items: 
- Alex M: draft module patterns & example by Tue (assigning internal due 1769540000)
- Jon S: prototype notebook + GH Action job
- Maya C: create test matrix + partner checklist
- Selena R: provision smoke pool and add credentials for CI
- Priya K: coordinate partner review invites + marketplace checklist liaison
I'll run kickoff Wed 10am PT and create a short project doc in the Partnerships space. Please add blockers below. React with :thumbsup: if you can attend.

CI-bot: Pipeline created: redwood/partner-iac-sprint — will run on branch partner/iac-sprint.

Selena R: :thumbsup: pool provisioned (small instance types), will scale if smoke tests need it.

Alex M: pushed initial module skeleton to branch partner/iac-sprint. PR: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/42 (WIP)

Jon S: added notebook and a short runbook to the PR. Will add the GH Action next.

Evan L: Awesome — I'll draft the partner-facing agenda and invite the SEs. Thanks all.

Maya C: One more ask: include an "observability checklist" in the runbook (token-level cost, latency traces, fallback policy notes). Partners always ask about telemetry.

Evan L: Good call — adding that to the runbook outline.

Priya K: I'll confirm partner attendees and send calendar invites after kickoff doc is live.

Alex M: quick note — reuse our module test helper: `scripts/test_module.sh` to keep smoke tests consistent.

Jon S: putting a TODO in the PR to wire `scripts/test_module.sh` into GH Actions.

CI-bot: Status: build started for PR #42.

Evan L: Thanks — ping me if anyone needs more time.
